info.name: Ink Indexer API
info.description: API collection for the Ink Chain Onchain Event Indexer — covers health checks, GraphQL queries for events, transfers, swaps, stats, and indexer status.

request.description: Returns the health status of the indexer including uptime, database connection, and latest indexed block.
Returns current indexer state: whether it's actively indexing, the last processed block, error count, and uptime in seconds.
Returns aggregate statistics: total events, transfers, swaps, and the latest block number in the database.

graphql.query:
query GetAllEvents($first: Int) {
  events(first: $first) {
    ... on ERC20Transfer {
      id
      blockNumber
      blockTimestamp
      transactionHash
      from
      to
      value
      tokenAddress
    }
    ... on Swap {
      id
      blockNumber
      blockTimestamp
      transactionHash
      poolAddress
      sender
      recipient
      amount0In
      amount1In
      amount0Out
      amount1Out
    }
  }
}

request.description: Returns all recent events (both ERC-20 transfers and swaps) using inline fragments on the Event union type.
Returns only ERC-20 Transfer events by filtering with the ERC20_TRANSFER type.
Returns only Swap events by filtering with the SWAP type.
Returns the most recent ERC-20 token transfers.
Returns ERC-20 transfers filtered by recipient address. Replace the address in variables with an actual address.
Returns ERC-20 transfers with cursor-based pagination. Set 'after' to the last item's ID from a previous response to get the next page.

graphql.query:
query GetRecentSwaps($first: Int) {
  swaps(first: $first) {
    id
    blockNumber
    blockTimestamp
    transactionHash
    poolAddress
    sender
    recipient
    amount0In
    amount1In
    amount0Out
    amount1Out
  }
}

request.description: Returns the most recent DEX swaps (Uniswap V2/V3).

graphql.query:
query GetSwapsByPool($poolAddress: String, $first: Int) {
  swaps(poolAddress: $poolAddress, first: $first) {
    id
    blockNumber
    blockTimestamp
    transactionHash
    poolAddress
    sender
    recipient
    amount0In
    amount1In
    amount0Out
    amount1Out
  }
}

request.description: Returns swaps filtered by a specific liquidity pool address.

graphql.query:
query GetSwapsPaginated($first: Int, $after: String) {
  swaps(first: $first, after: $after) {
    id
    blockNumber
    blockTimestamp
    transactionHash
    poolAddress
    sender
    recipient
    amount0In
    amount1In
    amount0Out
    amount1Out
  }
}

request.description: Returns swaps with cursor-based pagination. Set 'after' to the last item's ID from a previous response.

graphql.query:
query DashboardOverview {
  status {
    isIndexing
    lastBlockNumber
    errorCount
    uptime
  }
  stats {
    totalEvents
    totalTransfers
    totalSwaps
    latestBlock
  }
  transfers(first: 5) {
    id
    blockNumber
    transactionHash
    from
    to
    value
    tokenAddress
  }
  swaps(first: 5) {
    id
    blockNumber
    transactionHash
    poolAddress
    sender
    recipient
    amount0In
    amount1In
    amount0Out
    amount1Out
  }
}

request.description: A combined query that fetches everything needed for a dashboard: indexer status, stats, recent transfers, and recent swaps in a single request.
